backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining user roles, profiles, reports, admin allowlist logic, and access-control-integrated signup/reset flows. Includes full system reset and role assignment handling.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping app features to affected files, components, and test IDs with high‑level descriptions of required fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files describing functionality, auth flows, UI components, and deployment behavior.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android Trusted Web Activity, including prerequisites, PWA asset validation, and Bubblewrap/Android Studio build steps.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for the IC, covering local dev, mainnet deploys, required build versioning, upgrades, and post‑deploy validation steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH-based light/dark color variables and shared UI CSS tokens.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entrypoint loading the PWA manifest, icons, theme color, and mounting the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Defines the PWA manifest with app metadata, theme colors, and icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a versioned service worker handling precaching, runtime caching, activation logic, and network-first/static-first fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing and authentication flow, managing profile loading, error states, and conditional rendering of main app pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays an admin‑only access denied message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the top navigation header with user info, admin links, and logout and copy actions.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main app layout including header, banners, content area, and footer with build info.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login, stale-session cleanup, and provides signup/login UI.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows a warning banner when the device is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Implements the user profile setup form, validation, and signup flows for engineer and admin roles.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: UI banner that appears when a service worker update is available and lets the user trigger a reload.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Screen shown when a session is invalid, prompting the user to fully log out and sign in again.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine that clears identity, caches, storage, and optionally reloads or resets PWA state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook for one‑shot geolocation capture with status tracking, error handling, and optional auto‑capture.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth client state, login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks browser online/offline state via event listeners.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for profile and role operations scoped by principal to avoid cross‑account data leakage.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates, exposes an action to apply them, and triggers reload on activation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark theme colors and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point rendering the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing, filtering, and deleting users, and performing app-wide reset with dialogs and authorization checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a specific service report with loading, error handling, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating new service reports with validation, geolocation integration, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable and filterable list of reports with CSV export, user filtering, and copy-to-clipboard features.
frontend/src/utils/authClientIndexedDbCl: Utility that clears Internet Identity and AuthClient data from IndexedDB to prevent automatic re-authentication.
frontend/src/utils/authClientPersistentL: Creates a fresh AuthClient and logs it out to clear persisted auth state without throwing errors.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects missing-profile and genuine authentication errors by matching message patterns.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all localStorage and sessionStorage entries as a safe best‑effort reset utility.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates and exposes a build version identifier using env vars or fallbacks for cache/version tracking.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the modern API with a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Provides formatting helpers for principals and usernames, including truncated display forms.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all PWA Cache Storage entries and unregisters service workers with timeout-protected, non‑throwing logic.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a file download with a date‑based filename.
Extracts and sanitizes backend signup errors into user‑friendly messages while hiding internal details.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized logging and error‑cleaning utilities for signup flow debugging while redacting sensitive data.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates signup form fields such as required text, email format, and mobile number rules.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from session or the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme colors, sizing, animations, and plugin setup for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes current project state, issues, and requirements centered on fixing authentication, signup, logout, and related security problems.
